english:
Scoring 2 Precision Hits within 1 second against <arc Arc />-Debuffed enemies, or 3 <arc Arc />-Debuffed enemy Kills within 3 seconds, spawns an Ionic Trace.

Spawned Ionic Traces have a 5 second cooldown between them.

Collecting an Ionic Trace grants a stack of Armor Charge.

source.text:
Upon scoring 2 Precision Hits within 1 second of each against Arc-Debuffed Enemies, OR upon scoring 3 Arc-Debuffed Enemy Kills within 3 seconds of each:

Spawns an Ionic Trace.
Incurs a 5 second cooldown between Ionic Trace spawns.

On Ionic Trace Pickup:
Grants a stack of Armor Charge.
